theirReference: I met Cristian during my trip to Bogota, and I can honestly say he made my 3 days there unforgettable. Even before I arrive, we were already in touch, and it felt like I had a friend waiting for me in the city. From the moment I landed til my last day, he was there. Friendly, easy to talk to (esp that he knows english) and very genuine. On my 1st day, I invited him to my hotel and we went up to one of the most beautiful rooftop bars in Bogota to watch the sunset, had drinks, and get o know each other. We instantly clicked, finding so many similarities in life that made conversations flow so naturally. The next day he, he spend his whole time showing me around Bogota, from the breathtaking view on top of Monserrate to walking through the charming streets of La Candelaria where he even revealed his own “secret spots.” We tried delicious Cholado in a hidden corner. He wasn’t just a guide but was my new friend, and someone who shared his city with pride. Tnx for the memories and goodluck!
myReference: Princess, from Qatar 🇶🇦, stayed with me and was a wonderful guest. She was very kind and thoughtful. She even invited me to the Hilton rooftop to enjoy the amazing view, and we also went for a walk around La Candelaria and visited Monserrate together. She was always super gentle, respectful, and a pleasure to spend time with. I highly recommend her as a guest.

theirReference: Cristian has taken Couchsurfing hosting to another level--you'll see when you get there. He has a separate room for his guest and does his best to accommodate you and whatever needs you may have. He and his girlfriend are very accommodating. His mom is the sweetest! When I set to go to Monserrate, she had me take two bottles of water and an apple for 'the walk'. She also made coffee for us and had me try Colombian fruits. They have a friendly giant dog who's really just a playful baby, something to note when staying with them. I'd say that if you want a Colombian/Bogota experience, staying with Cristian's family will give you that! Bonus: The view from their rooftop is superb
